thread:
marta: Heads-up — tried flipping the FP8 kernel on for the H100/L40S rollout (kernel v0.9.2, runtime 2.3.1) against mpt-8b. Short prompts look fine but long-context sampling diverges and we see occasional NaNs in the attention path. Logs pasted below. :eyes:

kevin: Do you have the exact launch config? batch size, seq len, quant flags?

marta: Config snippet:
```
MODEL=mpt-8b
HW=H100
KERNEL=fp8_v0.9.2
BATCH=1
SEQ=2048
FP8_MODE=enable
PRECACHE=kv
```

marta: Repro: run `./bench_infer --model mpt-8b --seq 2048 --fp8` on L40S/H100 pools. Failure rate ~3% after ~120 tokens.

runtime-bot: rollout note: FP8 kernel currently enabled in canary. Fallback policy: mixed-precision -> float16 on exception.

yana: Two quick things to check: 1) activation scaling schedule between forward/backward (FP8 uses per-tensor scales) 2) whether KV cache memcpy paths are forcing an implicit cast. Both can cause softmax overflow.

kevin: Can you paste the failing stack? Also any seed + prompt to repro will help.

marta: Stack/log excerpt (truncated):
```
[E] 2026-04-07 14:12:01.342 infer.cpp:423 - attention_softmax: detected inf in logits
[E] 2026-04-07 14:12:01.343 kernel_fp8.cu:78 - fp8_dequantize: scale underflow -> denom=0
[E] 2026-04-07 14:12:01.343 runtime.cc:210 - fallback triggered: switching to fp16 path
Traceback (most recent call last):
  at libkernel::fp8_softmax(cudaStream_t=0x7f2...)
  at runtime::exec_attention

```

marta: prompt is a long multi-turn doc with repeated tokens (repro attached to GH).

kevin: This smells like a mixed-precision accumulation mismatch. On H100 we sometimes see different rounding behavior vs L40S after kernel fusion changes. Try forcing `FP8_USE_EMUL=1` to emulate quantization in f16 path, see if error persists. Also check that `scale_inv` isn't getting clamped to zero by integer truncation.

yana: Also try `KV_STRIDE_ALIGN=256` — we had a case where misaligned KV copies introduced garbage in the first tokens and amplified when FP8 scales were tiny.

marta: Quick experiment: emulation on -> no NaNs in 10k tokens, but performance down ~1.6x. With KV align change + emu off -> stable in 1000 tokens on L40S but H100 still flaky.

kevin: OK. Can you open a GH issue with kernel logs + two seed runs (emu on/off) and tag @kevin @yana? I'll add a bisect script to see whether fusion patch r4593 regressed it.

marta: Filed GH#2318: "fp8: intermittent NaN in attention on long prompts (H100/L40S)" — includes reproducer, logs, perf numbers. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/issues/2318 :link:

runtime-bot: Added milestone: fp8-stability-q2. Assigned: kevin, yana.

yana: If bisect points to fusion, we should add a short-circuit: if softmax logits variance < 1e-7 then do a safe f16 path rather than continuing fused fp8 ops. Safer fallback than blind exception.

kevin: Agreed. I'll prototype a cheap check inside the kernel. If it flips often, we can add a tunable threshold in config `FP8_SOFTMAX_SAFETY=1e-7`.

marta: Thanks — leaving canary enabled but adding the `KV_STRIDE_ALIGN` tweak and emulation toggle to the canary config for now. Will report back after 24h run. :thumbsup:

kevin: If this stabilizes, we'll push a patch to kernel v0.9.3 with the safety check + docs on expected degradation when emulation is enabled.

marta: update 24h: L40S stable, H100 failure rate dropped from 3% -> 0.1% with alignment + safety check in place. Still want a proper kernel fix.

yana: Cool. We'll keep bisecting and test on more models (gptq and awq variants) to ensure no regression.

kevin: Filed draft PR with safety check + config: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/2460 (WIP).

marta: closing loop here — thanks team. Will schedule a runtime postmortem if H100 flakiness resurfaces. :calendar:
